title: Go to Gram's
summary: Decide when to go, then lock up and leave. Use the Load-out list to pack and the Arrival list when you get there.

sources.title: CDC: Drinking Water Advisories, An Overview

phases.title: When we go (examples: edit these to fit your family)

items.text: Officials order an evacuation for our area
items.note: Follow local officials' instructions, and leave early enough to avoid being trapped by severe weather.

items.text: A hurricane or other severe storm is forecast for our area
items.note: If officials order an evacuation for your zone, leave immediately.

items.text: Our water is out, or under a do-not-drink or do-not-use advisory
items.note: Boiling does not make water safe under a do-not-drink advisory.

items.text: The power is out and there is no end in sight
items.note: In extreme heat or cold, officials say to go somewhere that has power.

items.text: Our home is damaged or unsafe to stay in
We cannot keep the insulin safe, or we are running low and cannot get more
items.note: See the insulin storage guide. The emergency supply guide covers getting more.

items.text: **Insulin into the travel cooler** and the T1D kit in the car.
Pack from the **Load-out list**, one tier at a time.
items.note: If you only have a few minutes, do just the first tier. The Load-out list is under Plans, then Go to Gram's, then Start packing.

items.text: Take the **pets**, with carriers or leashes.
items.note: If officials order an evacuation, pets should leave with you. Pets left behind may be lost or hurt.

items.text: Close and lock all doors and windows.
Unplug electrical equipment such as radios, TVs and small appliances.
Leave the fridge and freezer plugged in.
items.note: Unless there is a risk of flooding. The insulin goes with you.

items.text: Shut off water, gas and electricity **only if** your home is damaged and you have been told to.
Leave a note saying when you left and where you are going.
Tell friends and family, and the out-of-state contact, where you are going.
items.note: Tell them again when you arrive.

items.text: Check with neighbors who may need a ride.
Check the fuel. Fill the tank if evacuation looks likely.
items.note: Gas stations may close or be unable to pump during a power outage. Take one car per family.

items.text: Charge phones and power banks if you still have power.
Bring water and non-perishable food for the ride, and a battery-powered radio.
Follow recommended routes and avoid shortcuts, which may be blocked.
items.note: Watch for washed-out roads and bridges and for downed power lines. Do not drive into flooded areas.

items.text: When you get to Gram's, open the **Arrival list**.
items.note: It is under Plans, then Go to Gram's, then We're here.
